# HTTP status logging is distinct from SOAP operation success

Entry 1507 retrieves and logs the response status with request/operation identity. Current shared sender keeps that diagnostic before returning the HTTP response; status() can propagate an error from GetResponseStatus, but returning a numeric code is not the same as rejecting an HTTP error code. EWS separately interprets ResponseClass, returning its Error and logging Warning. Keep transport diagnostics and protocol success checks separate; no new logging privacy policy or runtime fix is inferred. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: EWS transport diagnostics.
